title: Remote Play Inviter - Discord Bot for Steam Remote Play Together Invitations
description: Easily invite friends to Steam Remote Play Together through Discord for free!

hero.h11:
Only one person

needs to own the game.
hero.p1: Post an invite panel in Discord, and everyone who presses the join button automatically gets a <b0>Steam Remote Play Together</b0> invite link. Your friends can play along without buying the game.
hero.p2: Free and open source · <a0>macOS and Linux</a0>

worry.t3: Every time a friend shows up, open Steam, make an invite link, copy, paste.
worry.t4: It falls apart as more join…
worry.t5: Third guest, fourth guest… The host is stuck handing out links and the game never starts.
worry.t7: The friend you want to invite doesn't have the game you want to play.
worry.t8: Inviting with Steam alone looks like this, for every guest
worry.h22:
Remote Play Inviter

fixes all of it!
worry.t9: Post the panel once. After that, each person who presses the button gets a link of their own.
worry.t10: Here is what it looks like for a guest
worry.attr1: A real recording: a guest presses the button on the Discord invite panel, an invite link arrives only for them, and the Steam invite page opens
worry.figcaption1: <span0>Real recording</span0> Press the button → a link only you can see → the Steam invite page

features.t3: With the Steam Link app, guests can play on a phone or tablet. No PC needed.
features.t5: Only the host needs to own the game. Guests don't even need a Steam account.
features.t7: Anything that supports Remote Play Together works. The bot tells you when a game doesn't.
features.t8: Add it to yourself, use it anywhere
features.t9: Add the bot to your own account and you can post invite panels in servers without the bot, in DMs and in group DMs.
features.t11: Only the host installs the client. Guests don't need to install anything.
features.t13: Published on GitHub under the MIT license. Forks and pull requests are welcome.

start.t1: Only the host has to set anything up. Guests just open the link they receive.
start.t3: We recommend adding it to your own account, so you can use it in servers without the bot and in DMs too.
start.t5: Start the client and link it
start.t6: Open it while Steam is running and a link command is copied for you. Just paste it into Discord and send.
start.p1: Start a game that supports Remote Play Together and type <code0>/steam invite</code0> wherever you want to invite people.
start.t11: Yes. Only the host needs to buy the game. Guests play for free.
start.t12: Do guests need to install anything?
start.t13: No. Only the host needs the client.
start.t14: How long does an invite panel work?
start.t15: Until you close the client. After restarting it, post a new panel.
start.t16: It says the invite link is invalid
start.t17: Invite links work only once. If you get disconnected, press the button again to get a new link.
start.t18: Can I use it in servers without the bot, or in DMs?
start.t19: Yes. Add the bot to your own account and you can use it in servers without the bot, in DMs and in group DMs. It won't work in servers that don't allow "Use External Apps".

faqController.q: Can I join without a controller?
faqController.a: Yes. On a phone, you can play with the on-screen buttons in Steam Link. On a PC, follow <link>the guide to turn your keyboard into a controller</link>.

start.t20: Is this an official Steam tool?
start.t21: No. Remote Play Together is an official Steam feature, but this tool is unofficial.
start.t22: Only the host needs to set it up. Guests just press a button.
start.t25: This is an unofficial tool not affiliated with Valve. Steam and Remote Play Together are trademarks of Valve Corporation.

wry.div8: <span0>2</span0>Create an invite link and copy it

cmp.attr1: On the left, Steam alone: the host makes an invite link in the Steam overlay, copies it and pastes it into Discord, one guest at a time. On the right, Remote Play Inviter: the host posts a panel once and three guests each press the button and join right away
cmp.t11: By hand, one guest at a time

stp.attr1: Starting the client copies a link command; pasting it into Discord and sending it links the client

phn.attr1: In the Discord app on a phone, pressing the join button on the invite panel sends an invite link only to you; Steam Link connects and you join the game as 2P in landscape
phn.t5: Let's play POCO PARK 2 together for free!

kmp.attr1: Pressing W, A, S and D on the keyboard moves the controller's left stick, and pressing K, L, J and I presses the A, B, X and Y buttons
kmp.t9: Your keyboard is now a controller!

gdl.attr1: On the official x360ce site, press DOWNLOAD FOR ALL GAMES for Version 4 on the left, not the two Version 3 buttons on the right. x360ce.zip downloads, and Extract All from the right-click menu gives you x360ce.exe
gdl.t1: Skip the two on the right
gdl.t2: Press this one, on the far left!

gis.label: If the Issues tab in x360ce shows a warning, open it and press Install for Virtual Device Driver until it says All OK. No issues were found.
gis.k3: Done when it says All OK!

gad.label: On the Controller 1 tab in x360ce, press Add..., pick the keyboard in Map Device To Controller and press Add Selected Device to add the keyboard

gps.label: Press Copy preset on this page, press Paste Preset in x360ce to fill every button field with values like Button 37, then save with Save All
gps.k1: ① Copy it on this page
gps.k2: ② Paste Preset fills in every key

gck.label: Ticking Enable 1 Mapped Device in x360ce makes Steam show the notification Controller connected: Xbox 360 Controller
gck.k1: Tick it to turn it ON

jph.attr1: Joining from a phone: press "Join the game" in Discord, press "Join Game" on the Steam page that opens, and Steam Link connects you to the game in landscape
jph.p1: <b0>Haru</b0> invited you to play POCO PARK 2
jph.t5: No Steam Link yet? Get it from this page

jpc.attr1: Joining from a PC: connect a controller, press "Join the game" in Discord, then press "Join Game" on the Steam page that opens to join the game
jpc.p1: <b0>Haru</b0> invited you to play POCO PARK 2
jpc.t5: No Steam? Get Steam Link from this page

hero.p1: The free tool <b0>x360ce</b0> lets you use your keyboard as an Xbox controller, so you can join Steam Remote Play Together as a "controller" even if you don't have one.

when.t2: Your keyboard stands in for a controller.
when.t4: Join games where only 1P can use the keyboard and everyone else needs a controller.
when.t5: Rather play on PC than phone
when.t6: Join from your PC, with a big screen and a keyboard.

ready.t5: The one you always use is fine.
ready.t7: You'll download it from the official site in step 1.

steps.t1: You only do this once. After that, just turn it ON as in step 5.
steps.li1: Open the official site and, in the top row, press <b1>DOWNLOAD FOR ALL GAMES</b1> for Version 4 on the <b0>far left</b0>.
steps.t3: The two on the right (32-BIT / 64-BIT GAMES) are Version 3, which works differently. Don't press them.
steps.li2: Right-click the downloaded <b0>x360ce.zip</b0> and choose Extract All. Any folder is fine.
steps.li5: If the <b0>Issues</b0> tab at the top shows a grey check mark, go straight to step 3.
steps.li6: If it shows ⚠, open it and press <b0>Install</b0> (or Download and Install) on the right.
steps.li7: You're done when <b0>All OK. No issues were found.</b0> appears at the bottom.
steps.div1:
Did it freeze after pressing Install?

Wait about 15 seconds, then force-quit x360ce and start it again.
steps.li8: On the <b0>Controller 1</b0> tab, press <b1>+ Add...</b1> at the top right.
steps.li9: In the Map Device To Controller list, pick your <b0>keyboard</b0>.
steps.li10: Press <b0>Add Selected Device</b0> and the keyboard is added.
steps.t7: Set all the keys at once
steps.attr1: W A S D for the left stick, K L J I for the A B X Y buttons
steps.li12: Press <b0>Paste Preset</b0> at the bottom of x360ce, and every key is assigned at once.
steps.li13: Save with <b0>Save All</b0> at the top right.
steps.li14: Tick <b0>Enable 1 Mapped Device</b0> at the top left to turn it ON. Untick it to turn it OFF.
steps.li15: If Steam is running, it shows "Controller connected: <b0>Xbox 360 Controller</b0>" at the bottom right. You're all set.
steps.li16: If Steam shows nothing, open <b0>Game Controllers...</b0> at the bottom left and check that <b1>Controller (XBOX 360 For Windows)</b1> says OK.
steps.t10: Now just join from the Steam invite link. When you're done playing, untick it to turn it OFF.
steps.t12: This is the map that the preset in step 4 sets up: move with WASD on your left hand, press buttons with IJKL on your right. It works for most games.
steps.t14: What's in the recommended preset (what step 4 copies)
steps.t15: In the format x360ce's Paste Preset reads.
steps.t16: Preset for Overcooked! 2 (move with the D-pad)
steps.t17: J throws, K picks up, L dashes. WASD is mapped to the D-pad.
steps.t20: Installing Virtual Device Driver can hang. Wait about 15 seconds, then force-quit x360ce and start it again.
steps.t21: It isn't recognized as a controller
steps.t22: Check whether the Issues tab shows ⚠. If it does, install as in step 2. Also make sure Enable 1 Mapped Device is ticked.
steps.t24: Press Download and Install on the right to install what's needed.
steps.t25: I want to change a button
steps.t26: Choose Record in the drop-down next to the button you want to change, then press the key you want. When a red ● blinks on the controller picture in the middle, it's assigned. Finish with Save All.
steps.t28: Untick Enable 1 Mapped Device to turn it OFF, and your keyboard goes back to normal.
steps.h22:
Once you're ready,

join from the invite link.
steps.t29: Press "Join the game" in Discord and play as usual.
steps.t31: x360ce is software by Jocys.com and is not affiliated with Remote Play Inviter. Screens are simplified for this guide.

meta.description: How to use your keyboard as an Xbox controller with the free tool x360ce, so you can join Steam Remote Play Together without a controller.
